clips.title: The story
paras: WANTED: Marez Cowl is an Alliance bounty quest issued against a high-ranking Syndicate operative entrenched within the ruins of Stromgarde. As both an influential advisor and a dark warlock trafficking with demons, Cowl represents a severe threat to the Alliance forces attempting to secure the Arathi Highlands.

WANTED: Marez Cowl is an Alliance bounty decree posted to eliminate one of the Syndicate's key leadership figures in the Arathi Highlands. Marez Cowl serves as a high-ranking advisor and field operative within the organization, orchestrating their activities in the ruined capital of Stromgarde. By placing a price on her head, Alliance commanders at Refuge Pointe aim to decapitate the Syndicate's local command structure.

Unlike typical brigands or dispossessed nobles among the Syndicate, Marez Cowl is a practitioner of dark sorcery. She is known as a cunning warlock who openly traffics with demonic powers to enforce her will and defend Syndicate territory. Approaching her lair within Stromgarde requires confronting not only cutthroats and conspirators, but the fell entities she commands.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A bounty has been placed on the head of Marez Cowl, a high-level advisor and operative of the Syndicate. She was last seen within the Syndicate controlled territory of Stromgarde.
Bounty may be collected from Captain Nials.
Be warned: Marez is a skilled and cunning Warlock, known for her trafficking with demons. Extreme caution is advised when hunting her.
